feature_guides.stage_body: Calm means nothing needs you. It turns worried for a warning and alarmed when something is ringing.
feature_guides.topics_body:
A topic is one alarm line. Your server sends it a message and your phone rings.
• Calm face: all quiet
• Red, alarmed face: something is ringing now
• payments-api is only an example. It disappears when you are done.
feature_guides.topics_body_example:
A topic is one alarm line. Your server sends it a message and your phone rings.
• Calm face: all quiet
• Red, alarmed face: something is ringing now
• All three are examples. They disappear when you are done.
feature_guides.compose_body: Tap + to create a new topic. Make one for each thing you watch.
feature_guides.create_name_body: Name it after what it watches, like prod-db or backups. The name is also its address: your server posts to /prod-db.
feature_guides.create_critical_body: Turn critical delivery on for pages that must wake you. Leave it off for everything else. You can change it later.
feature_guides.create_button_body: Tap Create and Crit Alarm shows the topic's address and token. The token shows once, so copy it into your script straight away.
feature_guides.search_body:
One search looks through:
• Topics, like "prod"
• Past alarms, like "yesterday"
• Settings, like "sound"
• The docs, like "docker"
feature_guides.search_settings_body: Type "sound" to jump straight to the alarm sound, or "dark" for the theme. No digging through menus.
feature_guides.search_docs_body: Type "uptime kuma" or "docker" to open a setup guide from critalarm.app.
feature_guides.topic_critical_body:
• On: rings like an alarm, even on silent, until you stop it
• Off: a normal notification that follows your phone's sound settings
feature_guides.topic_critical_body_time_sensitive:
• On: a Time-Sensitive notification with sound, repeated until you stop it. Silent mode mutes it on this phone
• Off: a normal notification that follows your phone's sound settings
feature_guides.topic_sound_body: Choose the alarm sound for this topic. The default for every topic lives in Settings.
feature_guides.topic_delete_body: Down here at the bottom. It removes the topic for good, and its address and tokens stop working.
feature_guides.history_body: Every alarm ends up here, with when it rang and when it was stopped.
feature_guides.health_body: Checks phone settings and recent alarm delivery. A number on this row means something needs a look.
feature_guides.replay_body: Each screen shows its own short guide the first time you open it. Tap Feature Guides any time to see them all again.
feature_guides.offer_body: A few short guides show where your topics, alarms and settings live. It takes about a minute.
feature_guides.offer_note: You can start it any time from Settings › Feature Guides.
feature_guides.picker_subtitle: Each guide points at the real screen. Skip any time.

samsung.name: Samsung
samsung.step_1: Open Settings, then Battery, then Background usage limits. On older versions, open Battery and device care first.
samsung.step_2: Tap Never sleeping apps, then +. Pick Crit Alarm and tap Add.
samsung.step_3: Open Sleeping apps and Deep sleeping apps. If Crit Alarm is in either one, remove it.

xiaomi.name: Xiaomi, Redmi, Poco
xiaomi.step_1: Open Settings, then Apps, and find Crit Alarm. On HyperOS, tap Manage apps first.
xiaomi.step_2: Turn on Autostart. On MIUI 14 it is under App permissions, as Background autostart.
xiaomi.step_3: Tap Battery saver (called Power on some versions) and choose No restrictions.
xiaomi.step_4: Open recent apps. Drag the Crit Alarm card down, or long-press it, and tap the padlock.

oppo.name: Oppo, Realme, OnePlus
oppo.step_1: Open Settings, then Apps, then App management. Tap Crit Alarm, then Battery usage.
oppo.note_versions: These steps are for ColorOS 11 to 14 and OxygenOS 12 and up.
oppo.note_realme: Realme: Settings, Battery, Power saving settings, App battery management.
oppo.note_oxygen: OxygenOS 11 or older: Settings, Battery, Battery optimization, Don't optimize.

huawei.name: Huawei, Honor
huawei.step_1: Open Settings, then Battery, then App launch.
huawei.step_2: Turn off Manage automatically for Crit Alarm.
huawei.step_3: In the box that opens, turn on Auto-launch, Secondary launch and Run in background. Tap OK.
huawei.step_4: EMUI 6 to 8: also open Settings, Advanced settings, Battery manager, Protected apps, and turn on Crit Alarm.
